expectations.text: Replaces the pasted press release with a post made by a participant, in that community's own register
expectations.evidence: Explicitly flags the plan's flaw: 'Press release pasted into Discord + two subreddits. A pasted press release in a community reads as spam/bot and gets removed... the post rewritten in that community's own register, problem-first, link last. Never the same blurb twice.' The runbook's T+2h–T+6h section repeats it operationally: Discord = 'showcase channel (not general), after confirming with a mod... Rewrite the framing for that room — problem and technical decision first, link at the end. No press release text'; subreddits = 'each independently rewritten: check each sidebar and the last month
